# Triport Logistics

> Triport Logistics LLC is a premier B2B freight forwarding, global multi-modal shipping, and supply chain management provider headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

## Organization Overview
- **Legal Name**: Triport Logistics LLC
- **Headquarters**: ACICO Business Park, Port Saeed / Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Port Operations Hub**: Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA South), Dubai, UAE
- **Pakistan Operations**: Plot 107, Block C1, Engineers Town, Lahore, Pakistan (Phone: +92 333 4448222)
- **Europe Regional Desk (Germany)**: CargoCity South, Building 537, Frankfurt Airport, Germany (Email: germany@triportlogistic.com)
- **Official Website**: https://www.triportlogistic.com
- **Direct Calling (UAE)**: +971 52 680 2328
- **WhatsApp Desk**: +971 56 656 9927
- **Commercial Email**: info@triportlogistic.com / quotes@triportlogistic.com
- **Primary Operational Ports**: Jebel Ali Port (DP World), Dubai International Airport (DXB), Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC), Khalifa Port Abu Dhabi

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Ocean Freight Forwarding (FCL & LCL)
- Full Container Load (FCL): 20ft, 40ft, 40ft High Cube, Open Top, Flat Rack, and Refrigerated (Reefer) containers.
- Less than Container Load (LCL): Weekly consolidation and deconsolidation at Jebel Ali Port CFS.
- Key Inbound Corridors: China (Shanghai, Ningbo, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Qingdao), Europe (Rotterdam, Hamburg, Genoa, Felixstowe), United States (Houston, Los Angeles, New York), India (Nhava Sheva, Mundra).
- Direct tier-1 contracts with major ocean carriers: MSC, Maersk, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, ONE.

### 2. International Air Cargo & Charters
- Scheduled cargo consolidation and express airport-to-airport air freight.
- Strategic airline partnerships with Emirates SkyCargo, Qatar Airways Cargo, Saudia Cargo, and European carriers.
- Full and part-charter aircraft services for urgent, high-value, or out-of-gauge industrial shipments.
- Complete temperature-controlled cold chain for pharmaceuticals, biotech, and perishable food products.

### 3. UAE Customs Clearance & Port Brokerage
- Authorized Dubai Customs broker operating direct Mirsal II digital connectivity via Dubai Trade.
- Clearance turnaround typically within 4 to 12 hours from cargo arrival.
- Specialization in Free Zone declarations (JAFZA, DAFZA, Dubai South, KIZAD) and duty exemption processing under Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MoIAT) guidelines.
- Coordination of regulatory inspections with Dubai Municipality, ESMA/MOIAT, and Port Health Authorities.

### 4. 3PL Warehousing & Distribution
- Bonded and ambient storage facilities strategically located in JAFZA and Dubai South.
- Real-time cloud Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) with barcode scanning, SKU tracking, and automated stock reports.
- Container cross-docking, devanning, palletizing, labeling, and pick-and-pack fulfillment.

### 5. GCC Cross-Border Land Transport
- Bonded overland trucking connecting the UAE to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), Oman (Muscat, Sohar), Qatar (Doha), Kuwait, and Bahrain.
- GPS-tracked fleet: 40ft skeletal chassis, dry box trailers, temperature-monitored reefers (-25°C to +25°C), and low-bed heavy haulers.
- Complete border documentation handling (Al Batha, Hatta, Al Wajajah) and Saudi Saber conformity coordination.

### 6. Project Cargo & Heavy Lift
- Engineering logistics for oil and gas, energy, construction, and infrastructure projects across the Middle East.
- Turnkey route surveys, crane rigging, barge charters, and police escort coordination.
